tools.name: search_episodes
tools.description: Search Yedapo's 5,000+ AI summaries of podcast and YouTube episodes. Matches words in the episode title, the show name, the summary's topic tags and its short teaser text (not full transcripts). Returns up to 10 matches, newest first within each match type, each with show, date, teaser, the episode

tools.name: get_episode
tools.description: Get one episode's full Yedapo summary as markdown: teaser, should-you-listen verdict, key takeaways with timestamps, a short verbatim source snippet with a timestamp when a transcript is available, chapter breakdown, and the page URL to cite. Newest summary added: 2026-11-05.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_episodes" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
